title: Peter Navarro
summary: White House trade and manufacturing counselor included because investigative reporting attributes initiation of the Vulcan Elements financing review to him.

sources.title: Company Tied to Donald Trump Jr. Got a Deal After White House Intervened

data.name: Peter Navarro
positions: Senior Counselor for Trade and Manufacturing
public_roles: Senior Counselor for Trade and Manufacturing
data.inclusion_reason: ProPublica attributed the White House request that initiated or accelerated review of Vulcan Elements' OSC financing to Navarro; this is a material process edge in the 1789–Vulcan branch.
data.evidence_boundary: The attribution is investigative reporting, not an adjudicated finding. Navarro did not respond to ProPublica, and the White House, Department of War, 1789 Capital, Donald Trump Jr. and Vulcan denied preferential treatment or involvement as described in the report.

caveats: The role is official; the Vulcan process edge remains attributed and contested.
No reviewed source establishes that Navarro acted at Donald Trump Jr.'s request.
No reviewed source establishes that the conditional loan closed or disbursed.
